title: centaurium chilense var. humile
intro: Centaurium chilense var. humile, commonly known as Giant Knapweed, is a plant species in the Gentianaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in South American folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant, making it useful in treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Centaurium chilense var. humile include its antimicrobial, antitussive, and spasmolytic properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
